paragraphs.text: Task heartbeat for DeepSeek Harness: progress beats and stall detection, not mere liveness.
# dsh-task-heartbeat
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-task-heartbeat) [](LICENSE)
> Author: jetpan (npm) ↔ jerentpan-lab (GitHub) | npm package | GitHub repo | install from GitHub: `
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jerentpan-lab/dsh-task-heartbeat`

Watch task **progress**, not process liveness. Register long tasks, beat after each
meaningful step,
and get a stalled list when the last beat is older than `ttl_s`.

Motivation: an agent can be alive and still stuck. A task that has not produced a beat
for 15 minute
s is stalled even if the process is running.

## Tools

- `task_register { taskId, owner, expect?, ttlS? }`
- `task_beat { taskId, note? }`
- `task_check` —

list stalled tasks
- `task_list`
- `task_done { taskId }`
## Config (0.2.0)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `stateFile`: heartbeat state file (default `~/.dsh/task-heartbeat.json`, env `DSH_TASK_HEARTBEAT_F

ILE`).
- `defaultTtlS`: default stall threshold for `task_register` when `ttlS` is omitted.
- Unknow

n keys / invalid values throw a readable `ConfigError`.
- Example: `config.example.json`. Run `npm r
un verify` for tests + pack checks.
## Demo
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Bench
`node bench/bench.mjs` writes `bench/RESULTS.md`. Each beat is a durable fsync'ed write (~97ms/beat
on this host); use `task_beat` at your task's natural cadence.
## Troubleshooting (error table)
| Symptom | Cause | Fix |

| `ConfigError ... unknown key` | typo/unsupported config key | use `config.example.json` |
| `Confi

gError ... defaultTtlS` | not a finite number > 0 | use seconds, e.g. 900 |
| `taskId must match ...

` | illegal id characters | `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}` only |
| `register: owner is required` | missing o

wner | pass `owner` |
| `register: task ... already running` | duplicate live task | use `force:true

` to restart |
| `ttlS must be a positive finite number` | bad ttl | pass seconds > 0 |
| `could not

acquire lock ...` | another process holds the lock >30s | retry; check for stale lock file |
| `sta
te corrupt` warning | JSON unreadable | corrupt file quarantined (`*.corrupt-*`), tools keep working

|
| `clockRollbackMs` warning | wall clock went backwards | monotonic clamp keeps ages non-negative
| `clockRollbackMs` warning | wall clock went backwards | monotonic clamp keeps ages non-negative |
